name: zscents-final-chapter
description: ZSCENTS — The Final Chapter: cinematic brand documentary (Remotion)

scripts.render: remotion render ZscentsFinalChapter out/_master.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=14 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --concurrency=4 && npm run finalize
scripts.render:preview: ffmpeg -y -i out/zscents-final-chapter.mp4 -vf scale=540:960 -c:v libx264 -crf 26 -preset slow -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart out/zscents-final-chapter-preview.mp4
scripts.finalize: ffmpeg -y -i out/_master.mp4 -vf scale=in_range=full:out_range=tv,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 15 -profile:v high -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -color_range tv -c:a copy -movflags +faststart out/zscents-final-chapter.mp4 && rm out/_master.mp4
